# FLX-3114: no generator plugin entry point has that name

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A bundle names a generator plugin by an entry-point name: a letter, then letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens, and never a module path, a file or an object reference. The engine reads only the entry points the group flux_engine.generators lists in this interpreter, and it found none of that name. The message says what this environment has. Install the distribution that provides the plugin, in the interpreter that runs the engine, or correct the name in the bundle. Nothing was imported.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3114
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
